    51	
    52	/-! ## The pointwise minimum -/
    53	
    54	/-- The candidate multiplicities of the base divisor of `T` relative to `A` at the closed
    55	point `p`: the values `(A + div f)ₚ` over nonzero `f ∈ T`, truncated to `ℕ` (faithful once
    56	`T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A))`, which makes every `A + div f` effective). -/
    57	def Scheme.baseDivisorSet (T : Submodule K X.functionField) (A : X.CurveDivisor)
    58	    (p : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X}) : Set ℕ :=
    59	  {n : ℕ | ∃ (f : X.functionField) (_ : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0),
    60	    (coeffAt p.2
    61	      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf))).toNat = n}
    62	
    63	/-- **The base multiplicity of `T` relative to `A` at a closed point**: the minimum of
    64	`(A + div f)ₚ` over nonzero `f ∈ T`. -/
    65	noncomputable def Scheme.baseDivisorAt (T : Submodule K X.functionField)
    66	    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (p : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X}) : ℕ :=
    67	  sInf (Scheme.baseDivisorSet K T A p)
    68	
    69	lemma Scheme.baseDivisorSet_nonempty {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
    70	    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) (p : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X}) :
    71	    (Scheme.baseDivisorSet K T A p).Nonempty := by
    72	  obtain ⟨f, hfT, hf⟩ := hT
    73	  exact ⟨_, f, hfT, hf, rfl⟩
    74	
    75	/-! ## The assembled base divisor -/
    76	
    77	/-- **The base divisor `bd(T)` of a subspace `T` relative to `A`**: the Weil divisor of
    78	pointwise base multiplicities. Finitely supported because `0 ≤ bd(T)ₚ ≤ (A + div f₀)ₚ`
    79	for the chosen nonzero `f₀ ∈ T`. -/
    80	noncomputable def Scheme.baseDivisor (T : Submodule K X.functionField)
    81	    (A : X.CurveDivisor) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) : X.CurveDivisor :=
    82	  Finsupp.onFinset
    83	    (toFinsupp (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    84	      (Units.mk0 hT.choose hT.choose_spec.2))).support
    85	    (fun p => (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A p : ℤ))
    86	    (fun p hp => by
    87	      rw [Finsupp.mem_support_iff]
    88	      intro hzero
    89	      apply hp
    90	      have hle : Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A p
    91	          ≤ (coeffAt p.2 (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    92	              (Units.mk0 hT.choose hT.choose_spec.2))).toNat :=
    93	        Nat.sInf_le ⟨hT.choose, hT.choose_spec.1, hT.choose_spec.2, rfl⟩
    94	      have hc : coeffAt p.2 (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
    95	          (Units.mk0 hT.choose hT.choose_spec.2)) = 0 := hzero
    96	      omega)
    97	
    98	/-- The pointwise value of the base divisor is the base multiplicity. -/
    99	lemma Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor {T : Submodule K X.functionField} {A : X.CurveDivisor}
   100	    (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   101	    coeffAt hx (Scheme.baseDivisor K T A hT)
   102	      = (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ) :=
   103	  rfl
   104	
   105	/-- **The base divisor is effective.** -/
   106	lemma Scheme.baseDivisor_nonneg {T : Submodule K X.functionField} {A : X.CurveDivisor}
   107	    (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) : 0 ≤ Scheme.baseDivisor K T A hT := by
   108	  refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun x hx => ?_)
   109	  rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor K hT hx]
   110	  positivity
   111	
   112	/-! ## The lower-bound and achiever properties -/
   113	
   114	/-- Under `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A))`, the shifted divisor `A + div f` of a nonzero `f ∈ T` is
   115	effective at every closed point. -/
   116	lemma Scheme.coeffAt_add_divOf_nonneg {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   117	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) {f : X.functionField}
   118	    (hfT : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   119	    0 ≤ coeffAt hx
   120	      (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf)) := by
   121	  have hmem := hTA hfT
   122	  rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff K hf] at hmem
   123	  have h := CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mp hmem x hx
   124	  rwa [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at h
   125	
   126	/-- **The lower-bound property of the base divisor**: `bd(T) ≤ A + div f` pointwise, for
   127	every nonzero `f ∈ T`. -/
   128	lemma Scheme.baseDivisorAt_le_coeffAt {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   129	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) {f : X.functionField}
   130	    (hfT : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   131	    (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ)
   132	      ≤ coeffAt hx
   133	          (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf)) := by
   134	  have h1 : Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩
   135	      ≤ (coeffAt hx
   136	          (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf))).toNat :=
   137	    Nat.sInf_le ⟨f, hfT, hf, rfl⟩
   138	  have h2 := Scheme.coeffAt_add_divOf_nonneg K hTA hfT hf hx
   139	  omega
   140	
   141	/-- **The achiever**: at every closed point, some nonzero `f ∈ T` attains the base
   142	multiplicity: `(A + div f)ₓ = bd(T)ₓ`. -/
   143	lemma Scheme.exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   144	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0)
   145	    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   146	    ∃ (f : X.functionField) (_ : f ∈ T) (hf : f ≠ 0),
   147	      coeffAt hx (A + Scheme.divOf (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf))
   148	        = (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ) := by
   149	  have hmem : Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ ∈ Scheme.baseDivisorSet K T A ⟨x, hx⟩ :=
   150	    Nat.sInf_mem (Scheme.baseDivisorSet_nonempty K A hT ⟨x, hx⟩)
   151	  obtain ⟨f, hfT, hf, heq⟩ := hmem
   152	  refine ⟨f, hfT, hf, ?_⟩
   153	  have h2 := Scheme.coeffAt_add_divOf_nonneg K hTA hfT hf hx
   154	  omega
   155	
   156	/-! ## The normalization: `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A − bd T))` with no residual base point -/
   157	
   158	/-- **The base-divisor normalization**: `T ⊆ H⁰(𝒪(A − bd T))` — every nonzero `f ∈ T`
   159	has `(A − bd T) + div f ≥ 0` because `bd(T)` is a pointwise minimum. -/
   160	theorem Scheme.le_divisorSections_sub_baseDivisor {T : Submodule K X.functionField}
   161	    {A : X.CurveDivisor} (hTA : T ≤ divisorSections K A ⊤) (hT : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) :
   162	    T ≤ divisorSections K (A - Scheme.baseDivisor K T A hT) ⊤ := by
   163	  intro f hfT
   164	  by_cases hf : f = 0
   165	  · subst hf
   166	    exact Submodule.zero_mem _
   167	  · rw [mem_divisorSections_top_iff K hf]
   168	    refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun x hx => ?_)
   169	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub,
   170	      Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor K hT hx]
   171	    have h4 := Scheme.baseDivisorAt_le_coeffAt K hTA hfT hf hx
   172	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add] at h4
   173	    omega
   174	
   175	/-- **No residual base point** (the `hbpf` input of the bpf-span lemma): relative to the
   176	normalized divisor `A − bd T`, the subspace `T` has an exact-order element at every
   177	closed point: `((A − bd T) + div f)ₓ = 0`. -/

   108	theorem divUniversalFibre_mulSpan_eq_of_pack
   109	    (beta : Int)

   111	      beta ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K W →
   112	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C K).divisorSheaf K W) 1))
   113	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : Int) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hpi g))
   114	    (hSdeg : 2 * (g : Int) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K (windowS C K hpi g))
   115	    (hbetaS : beta + 2 * (g : Int) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K (windowS C K hpi g))
   116	    (hbetaN : beta + 2 * (g : Int) + CurveDivisor.deg K (windowS C K hpi g)
   117	      ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K (windowN C K hpi g)) :
   118	    Scheme.mulSpan K (Scheme.divisorSections K (windowS C K hpi g) ⊤)
   119	        (divUniversalFibreKM C hpi g r1 r2 b1 i j K)
   120	      = divUniversalFibreK' C hpi g r1 r2 b2 i j K := by
   121	  classical
   122	  have hOK : Sheaf.h0 ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 :=
   123	    h0_relCurve_baseField C K
   124	  have hchiK : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C K).moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : Int) :=
   125	    chi_relCurve_baseField C K g hchi
   126	  have hKMle := divUniversalFibreKM_le C hpi g r1 r2 b1 i j K
   127	  have hKMrank := finrank_divUniversalFibreKM_add C hpi g r1 r2 b1 i j K hchi
   128	  have hK'le := divUniversalFibreK'_le C hpi g r1 r2 b2 i j K
   129	  have hK'rank := finrank_divUniversalFibreK'_add C hpi g r1 r2 b2 i j K hchi
   130	  have hcarve := divUniversalFibre_carve C hpi g r1 r2 b1 b2 i j K hker
   131	  have hpack := existsUnique_effective_divisor_of_carve_pack g hOK hchiK
   132	    (windowN C K hpi g) (windowS C K hpi g) beta hvan hNdeg hSdeg hbetaS hbetaN
   133	    (divUniversalFibreKM C hpi g r1 r2 b1 i j K) hKMle hKMrank
   134	    (divUniversalFibreK' C hpi g r1 r2 b2 i j K) hK'le hK'rank hcarve

   136	
   137	  have hSdeg0 : 0 ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K (windowS C K hpi g) := by omega
   138	  have hNnorm : forall D' : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor,

   153	    rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hKMrank
   154	    omega
   155

   160	    exact (baseDivisorAt_window_normalization g hOK hchiK

   183	      (divUniversalFibreKM C hpi g r1 r2 b1 i j K) hKMsub 0 (Nat.zero_le g) hcrank hbpf

   112	/-- **Unit sections have trivial order.** The germ at `η` of a unit section over an open

   119	  rw [Scheme.ordZ_eq_one_iff]

   121	    (X.mem_basicOpen (u : Γ(X, U)) x hxU).mpr
   122	      (u.isUnit.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom)

   140	/-- **Piece-independence of the order.** At a closed point `x` of a piece
   141	`P.cover.opens y`, the trivializing element of that piece has the same order as the
   142	trivializing element of the piece indexed by `x` itself: their ratio is the germ of a
   143	unit section on the overlap. -/
   144	theorem ordZ_elem_eq (P : X.MeromorphicPresentation) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X)
   145	    {y : X} (hxy : x ∈ P.cover.opens y) :
   146	    Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (P.elem y)
   147	      = Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (P.elem x) := by
   148	  have key := congrArg (Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx) (P.ratio x y)
   149	  rw [map_mul, map_inv,
   150	    ordZ_germGenericUnits K (P.cover.genericPoint_mem_inf x y) _ hx
   151	      ⟨P.cover.mem_opens x, hxy⟩] at key
   152	  exact (mul_inv_eq_one.mp key).symm

   156	/-- **Finite support.** The closed points at which the (piece-indexed) trivializing
   157	element has nontrivial order form a finite set: finitely many pieces cover the
   158	quasi-compact curve, and on each piece the orders are those of a single rational
   159	function. -/
   160	theorem ordZ_elem_support_finite (P : X.MeromorphicPresentation) :
   161	    {p : {x : X // x ≠ genericPoint X} |
   162	      Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) p.2 (P.elem p.1) ≠ 1}.Finite := by
   163	  haveI : CompactSpace X :=
   164	    QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   165	  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := isCompact_univ.elim_finite_subcover
   166	    (fun i : X => (P.cover.opens i : Set X)) (fun i => (P.cover.opens i).isOpen)
   167	    (fun x _ => Set.mem_iUnion.mpr ⟨x, P.cover.mem_opens x⟩)
   168	  refine Set.Finite.subset (Set.Finite.biUnion t.finite_toSet
   169	    (fun i _ => Scheme.ordZ_support_finite (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (P.elem i))) ?_
   170	  intro p hp
   171	  obtain ⟨i, hit, hpi⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp (ht (Set.mem_univ p.1))
   172	  refine Set.mem_biUnion hit ?_
   173	  change Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) p.2 (P.elem i) ≠ 1
   174	  rw [P.ordZ_elem_eq K p.2 hpi]

   180	
   181	/-- **The divisor of a meromorphic presentation** (the W2 deliverable): the Weil divisor
   182	whose multiplicity at a closed point `x` is the order of vanishing at `x` of the
   183	trivializing element `P.elem x` of the piece indexed by `x`. By piece-independence
   184	(`MeromorphicPresentation.ordZ_elem_eq`) this is the order of the local trivialization
   185	of the presented class near `x`, whichever piece is used to read it off. -/
   186	noncomputable def presentationDivisor [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
   187	    (P : X.MeromorphicPresentation) : X.CurveDivisor :=
   188	  Finsupp.onFinset (P.ordZ_elem_support_finite K).toFinset
   189	    (fun p => Multiplicative.toAdd
   190	      (Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) p.2 (P.elem p.1)))
   191	    (fun p hp => by
   192	      rw [Set.Finite.mem_toFinset]
   193	      exact fun he => hp (by rw [he, toAdd_one]))

   201	      = Multiplicative.toAdd (Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (P.elem x)) :=

    34	    (e : A ≃+* B) {x : A} (hx : x ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) :
    35	    e x ∈ nonZeroDivisors B := by
    36	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff] at hx ⊢
    37	  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := hx
    38	  constructor
    39	  · intro y hy

    41	    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
    42	    have hy0 : e.symm y = 0 := hl _ h
    43	    calc y = e (e.symm y) := (e.apply_symm_apply y).symm
    44	      _ = 0 := by rw [hy0, map_zero]
    45	  · intro y hy
    46	    have h := congrArg e.symm hy
    47	    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
    48	    have hy0 : e.symm y = 0 := hr _ h
    49	    calc y = e (e.symm y) := (e.apply_symm_apply y).symm
    50	      _ = 0 := by rw [hy0, map_zero]

   489	/-- If every pulled local equation is regular at its own point, then every pulled

   492	theorem pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_self_pullbackEqn
   493	    (hreg : ∀ z : relCurve C R',

   495	        ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens z) z

   501	      nonZeroDivisors
   502	        Γ(relCurve C R', (A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j) := by
   503	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
   504	  intro t ht
   505	  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext (relCurve C R').sheaf
   506	    ((A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j) t 0
   507	  intro z hzj

   510	      ((A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom (A.pulledEqn R' j) ∈

   542	adaptation piece remains a nonzerodivisor after tensoring with every residue field.
   543	It uses only the seed's `fibre_regular` clause and the adaptation's `eqn_rel`; no
   544	colength finiteness, flatness, projectivity, or certificate is assumed. -/
   545	theorem eqn_tmul_one_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_seed
   546	    (j : A.index) (p : PrimeSpectrum R) :

   556	    apply e.injective
   557	    rw [e.apply_symm_apply]
   558	    exact (A.toFinCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange_one_tmul
   559	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField j (A.eqn j)).symm

   561	    nonZeroDivisors
   562	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[R] Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j)) at hback

   109	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

   112	/-- **Unit sections have trivial order.** The germ at `η` of a unit section over an open
   113	`U` has order zero at every closed point of `U`: locally the rational function is a unit
   114	of the structure sheaf. This is the local vanishing statement behind the
   115	piece-independence of `presentationDivisor`. -/
   116	theorem ordZ_germGenericUnits {U : X.Opens} (hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U) (u : Γ(X, U)ˣ)
   117	    {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) (hxU : x ∈ U) :
   118	    Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (germGenericUnits hηU u) = 1 := by
   119	  rw [Scheme.ordZ_eq_one_iff]
   120	  have hmem : x ∈ X.basicOpen (u : Γ(X, U)) :=
   121	    (X.mem_basicOpen (u : Γ(X, U)) x hxU).mpr
   122	      (u.isUnit.map (X.presheaf.germ U x hxU).hom)
   123	  exact Scheme.ord_eq_one_of_mem_basicOpen (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx
   124	    (u : Γ(X, U)) hηU hmem

   126	/-- The bridge between the classical order `ordZ` and the mathlib valuation `ord`: the
   127	inverse of `ordZ` (recall the sign inversion in its definition), coerced into `ℤᵐ⁰`, is
   128	the valuation of the underlying rational function. -/
   129	theorem coe_inv_ordZ (g : X.functionFieldˣ) {x : X} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X) :
   130	    (((Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx g)⁻¹ : Multiplicative ℤ) :
   131	        WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
   132	      = Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hx (g : X.functionField) := by
   133	  rw [Scheme.ordZ]
   134	  simp only [MonoidHom.comp_apply, invMonoidHom_apply, inv_inv, MulEquiv.coe_toMonoidHom,
   135	    WithZero.coe_unitsWithZeroEquiv_eq_units_val]
   136	  rfl

   138	namespace MeromorphicPresentation
   139	
   140	/-- **Piece-independence of the order.** At a closed point `x` of a piece
   141	`P.cover.opens y`, the trivializing element of that piece has the same order as the
   142	trivializing element of the piece indexed by `x` itself: their ratio is the germ of a
   143	unit section on the overlap. -/

   122	/-- **The relative achiever lift** (redesign brick 2, `informal/spec-dd4-redesign.md` §1.2):
   123	at a field point `K` of the tower `R_{I,J} → R_Z → K`, given any pole bound `A` under which
   124	the fibre window `divUniversalFibreKM` sits inside `H⁰(𝒪(A))` and is nonzero, and any closed
   125	point `z`, some universal window vector `x ∈ divUniversalFstWindow` has
   126	
   127	* its window image `relThetaWindowEquiv … x` in `divUniversalSeedK` (a relative seed
   128	  section, by definition of `divUniversalSeedK`);
   129	* a non-vanishing fibre comparison `windowCompare R_Z K x ≠ 0`;
   130	* a `Φ`-read `Φ(windowCompare R_Z K x)` that **achieves** the base multiplicity of the
   131	  fibre window relative to `A` at `z`: `(A + div Φ(…))_z = bd(divUniversalFibreKM)_z`.
   132	
   133	This is the achiever the seed's `sec z` needs (dissolving I-0288's `hle` razor at `z`),
   134	built by the *surjection lift* — `divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span` presents the fibre window as
   135	the `κ(p)`-span of the readings, and `Scheme.exists_achiever_of_span` (the ultrametric
   136	span-minimality keystone) locates an achiever *among* the readings. -/
   137	theorem exists_achiever_relThetaWindowEquiv_mem_divUniversalSeedK
   138	    {A : (relCurve C K).CurveDivisor}
   139	    (hA : divUniversalFibreKM C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ i j K
   140	      ≤ Scheme.divisorSections K A ⊤)
   141	    (hne : divUniversalFibreKM C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ i j K ≠ ⊥)
   142	    {z : ↥(relCurve C K)} (hz : z ≠ genericPoint (relCurve C K)) :
   143	    ∃ x ∈ (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule,
   144	      relThetaWindowEquiv C
   145	          (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   146	            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
   147	          π (windowM_choice π hπ g) (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g) x
   148	        ∈ divUniversalSeedK C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j ∧
   149	      windowCompare
   150	          (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   151	            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) K x ≠ 0 ∧
   152	      ∃ hr : divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g) (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   153	          (windowCompare
   154	            (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   155	              (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) K x) ≠ 0,
   156	        coeffAt hz (A + Scheme.divOf (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   157	            (Units.mk0 (divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   158	                (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   159	                (windowCompare
   160	                  (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   161	                    (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j)
   162	                  K x)) hr))
   163	          = (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K (divUniversalFibreKM C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ i j K) A
   164	              ⟨z, hz⟩ : ℤ) := by
   165	  classical
   166	  -- the fibre window is the `K`-span of the `Φ`-read fibre comparisons of the window
   167	  have hspan := divUniversalFibreKM_eq_span C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j K
   168	  rw [hspan] at hA hne ⊢
   169	  -- the span is nonzero, so it has a nonzero element
   170	  have hT := (Submodule.ne_bot_iff _).mp hne
   171	  -- the achiever of the span is achieved *on the spanning set* (ultrametric minimality)
   172	  obtain ⟨f, hfS, hf, hach⟩ := Scheme.exists_achiever_of_span K hA hT hz
   173	  -- unpack the achiever as a `Φ`-read of a universal window vector `x` (β-reduce the image)
   174	  obtain ⟨x, hxW, hxf⟩ := hfS
   175	  simp only at hxf
   176	  refine ⟨x, hxW, Submodule.mem_map_of_mem hxW, ?_, ?_⟩
   177	  · -- the fibre comparison is nonzero (`Φ` sends it to the nonzero achiever)
   178	    intro h0
   179	    exact hf (by rw [← hxf, h0, map_zero])
   180	  · -- the `Φ`-read achieves the base multiplicity at `z`
   181	    have hr : divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g) (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   182	        (windowCompare
   183	          (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   184	            (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) K x) ≠ 0 := by
   185	      rw [hxf]; exact hf
   186	    refine ⟨hr, ?_⟩
   187	    have hunit : Units.mk0 (divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   188	          (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   189	          (windowCompare
   190	            (DivCarveChartRing k (windowS_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π)
   191	              (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j) K x)) hr
   192	        = Units.mk0 f hf := Units.ext hxf
   193	    rw [hunit]
   194	    exact hach

   106	  exact ((relCurve C K).presheaf.germ (relPinnedChart C K π b) zK hzK).hom
   107	      (relThetaResSide (windowM_choice π hπ g) b le_rfl
   108	        (relThetaWindowEquiv C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   109	          (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g) (windowCompare RZ K x)))

   116	/-- Nonzero compared universal-window readings are divisible by the pointwise achiever in
   117	the residue-fibre stalk. -/
   118	theorem pointwiseFibreReadGerm_dvd_of_ne
   119	    (z : relCurve C RZ)
   120	    (hzg : relCurveResiduePoint C RZ z ≠
   121	      genericPoint (relCurve C (relCurveBasePoint C RZ z).asIdeal.ResidueField))
   122	    (b : Bool) (hz : z ∈ relPinnedChart C RZ π b)
   123	    {xψ : RZ ⊗[k] ↥(Scheme.divisorSections k
   124	      (windowM_choice π hπ g • fiberWeilDivisor π) ⊤)}
   125	    (hxψ : xψ ∈ (divUniversalFstWindow C π hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j).toSubmodule)
   126	    (hxψzero : windowCompare RZ (relCurveBasePoint C RZ z).asIdeal.ResidueField xψ ≠ 0) :
   127	    pointwiseFibreReadGerm C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j z b hz
   128	        (pointwiseSectionVector C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z) ∣
   129	      pointwiseFibreReadGerm C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j z b hz xψ := by
   130	  let K := (relCurveBasePoint C RZ z).asIdeal.ResidueField
   131	  let A := pointwiseFibrePoleDivisor C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z
   132	  have hTA : divUniversalFibreKM C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ i j K ≤
   133	      Scheme.divisorSections K A ⊤ := by
   134	    simpa only [K, A] using divUniversalFibreKM_le_pointwiseFibrePoleDivisor
   135	      C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z
   136	  obtain ⟨hsec_ne, hach⟩ :=
   137	    pointwiseSectionVector_fibreAchieverData
   138	      C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z hzg
   139	  have hψ_ne : divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   140	      (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g) (windowCompare RZ K xψ) ≠ 0 := by
   141	    intro hzero
   142	    apply hxψzero
   143	    exact (divFamPhi_injective C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   144	      (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)) (by simpa using hzero)
   145	  have hψmem := divFamPhi_windowCompare_mem_divUniversalFibreKM
   146	    C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j K hxψ
   147	  unfold pointwiseFibreReadGerm
   148	  apply germ_relThetaResSide_windowEquiv_dvd_of_achiever
   149	    K C π (windowM_choice π hπ g) (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   150	      hTA
   151	      (windowCompare RZ K
   152	        (pointwiseSectionVector C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z))
   153	      (windowCompare RZ K xψ) hsec_ne hψ_ne hψmem b le_rfl
   154	      (relCurveResiduePoint_mem_relPinnedChart C RZ (π := π) b hz) hzg
   155	      hach

   114	/-- The compared pointwise vector is the fibre achiever, including its nonvanishing and

   118	    (hzg : relCurveResiduePoint C RZ z ≠
   119	      genericPoint (relCurve C (relCurveBasePoint C RZ z).asIdeal.ResidueField)) :

   121	    let A := pointwiseFibrePoleDivisor C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z
   122	    ∃ hr : divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   123	        (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   124	        (windowCompare RZ K
   125	          (pointwiseSectionVector C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z)) ≠ 0,
   126	      coeffAt hzg
   127	          (A + Scheme.divOf (relCurve C K ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   128	            (Units.mk0 (divFamPhi C K π (windowM_choice π hπ g)
   129	              (relThetaPairH1_windowM C π hπ g)
   130	              (windowCompare RZ K
   131	                (pointwiseSectionVector C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z))) hr))
   132	        = (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K (divUniversalFibreKM C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ i j K) A
   133	          ⟨relCurveResiduePoint C RZ z, hzg⟩ : ℤ) := by

   138	    C hπ g r₁ r₂ b₁ b₂ i j hO hχ z hzg
   139	  rw [hsec_eq]

    14	(`informal/dat-d-worksheet.md` §2.3.4; `informal/spec-dd-r.md` §3 item 7's fibrewise
    15	input): the **base divisor of the window is the family divisor**, so two families with
    16	equal `ε`-windows cut equal divisors, hence are `DivEq`
    17	(`divFamDivisor_injective`, the landed DD-1c converse dictionary) — `divFamEps` is
    18	injective on field points.  Equality of the FIRST components `K_M(d)` alone suffices.
    19

    21	
    22	Fibrewise this is exactly the route DDR-8 consumes (spec-dd-r §3 items 7–8): the window
    23	is read through the **sections dictionary** as `H⁰(𝒪(N − D_F)) ⊆ K(Y)` at the
    24	transported embedding level `N`; the certified-degree pinch (`deg_divFamDivisor_of_carve`,
    25	DDR-2) gives `deg D_F = g`; then the abstract-`N` recovery
    26	(`baseDivisorAt_window_normalization`, DDR-2's stated DDR-8 hook) presents `D_F` as the
    27	base divisor of that section space.  The base divisor is a function of the section space
    28	alone, so equal windows force equal divisors.
    29	
    30	## Layout
    31	
    32	* **§1 The generic recovery** (abstract curve `Y` over a field `K`, the CarveDegreePinch
    33	  pack): `baseDivisor_window_normalization` — the assembled-`baseDivisor` form of the
    34	  DDR-8 hook (`bd(H⁰(𝒪(N − D))) = D`); `eq_of_divisorSections_window_eq` — **uniqueness
    35	  of an effective degree-`g` divisor from its window section space**;

    39	  `baseDivisor_map_divFamEps` — **the window-recovery keystone**
    40	  `bd(Φ(K_M(d))) = divFamDivisor F`, in the pointwise shape DDR-8's fibrewise step
    41	  consumes and in assembled form; `eq_of_divFamEps_fst_eq` / `eq_of_divFamEps_eq` —

    45

    47	  (`thetaGluedEval_surjective`, `Picard/DivisorThetaSurjectivity.lean`, gated on the

    84	
    85	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    86	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    87	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    88	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    89	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    90	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    91	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)]
    92	
    93	omit [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    94	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    95	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    96	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)] in
    97	/-- **The `h⁰` shadow of a submodule-level sections dictionary**: an injective `K`-linear
    98	reading `Φ` of an ambient module into the function field that carries a submodule `E`
    99	onto the section space `H⁰(𝒪(A))` identifies dimensions — `h⁰(𝒪(A)) = dim_K E`.  This
   100	derives DDR-2's threaded `hdict` from the submodule-form dictionary `hE`, so consumers
   101	of the dictionary map need not thread the `h⁰` form separately. -/
   102	theorem h0_eq_finrank_of_map_eq {V : Type u} [AddCommGroup V] [Module K V]
   103	    {Φ : V →ₗ[K] Y.functionField} (hΦinj : Function.Injective Φ)
   104	    {E : Submodule K V} {A : Y.CurveDivisor}
   105	    (hE : Submodule.map Φ E = divisorSections K A ⊤) :
   106	    Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K A) = Module.finrank K ↥E := by
   107	  rw [← finrank_divisorSections_top K A, ← hE]
   108	  exact ((Submodule.equivMapOfInjective Φ hΦinj E).finrank_eq).symm
   109	
   110	/-- **Recovery of the divisor from its window, assembled form** (the `baseDivisor`
   111	packaging of DDR-2's `baseDivisorAt_window_normalization`, the DDR-8 hook): for an
   112	effective `D` of degree `g` under an embedding level `N` with exact normalization
   113	windows and budget `2g ≤ deg N`, any submodule `T` equal to the window section space
   114	`H⁰(𝒪(N − D))` has base divisor exactly `D` relative to `N`. -/
   115	theorem baseDivisor_window_normalization (g : ℕ)
   116	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
   117	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   118	    (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
   119	    (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
   120	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
   121	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
   122	    (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (hD0 : 0 ≤ D) (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ))
   123	    {T : Submodule K Y.functionField} (hT : T = divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤)
   124	    (hne : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0) :
   125	    Scheme.baseDivisor K T N hne = D := by
   126	  refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt (fun x hx => ?_)
   127	  rw [Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor K hne hx, hT]
   128	  exact baseDivisorAt_window_normalization g hO hχ N hNnorm hNdeg D hD0 hdeg hx
   129	
   130	omit [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] in
   131	/-- **The window section space is nonzero** (discharges the `hne` slot of
   132	`baseDivisor_window_normalization` from the pack itself): under the pinch pack, the
   133	window `H⁰(𝒪(N − D))` of an effective degree-`g` divisor has
   134	`h⁰ = deg N − 2g + 1 ≥ 1`, so any submodule equal to it has a nonzero element. -/
   135	theorem exists_mem_ne_zero_of_window_normalization (g : ℕ)
   136	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   137	    (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
   138	    (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
   139	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
   140	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
   141	    (D : Y.CurveDivisor) (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ))
   142	    {T : Submodule K Y.functionField} (hT : T = divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤) :
   143	    ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0 := by
   144	  have hgnn : (0 : ℤ) ≤ (g : ℤ) := Int.natCast_nonneg g
   145	  have hg2 : CurveDivisor.deg K D ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) := by omega
   146	  have hrank : (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)) : ℤ)
   147	      = CurveDivisor.deg K N - CurveDivisor.deg K D
   148	        + Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) := by
   149	    rw [h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one _ (hNnorm D hg2),
   150	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K]
   151	  rw [hχ, hdeg] at hrank
   152	  have hfr : Module.finrank K ↥T = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D)) := by
   153	    rw [hT]
   154	    exact finrank_divisorSections_top K _
   155	  refine Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (fun hbot => ?_)
   156	  rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hfr
   157	  omega
   158	
   159	/-- **Uniqueness of an effective degree-`g` divisor from its window section space** (the
   160	field-level heart of Task 6, family-free): under the pinch pack, two effective
   161	degree-`g` divisors with the same window section space `H⁰(𝒪(N − ·))` coincide — both
   162	are presented as the base divisor of the common section space
   163	(`baseDivisorAt_window_normalization`), which is a function of that space alone. -/
   164	theorem eq_of_divisorSections_window_eq (g : ℕ)
   165	    (hO : Sheaf.h0 (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1)
   166	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   167	    (N : Y.CurveDivisor)
   168	    (hNnorm : ∀ D' : Y.CurveDivisor, CurveDivisor.deg K D' ≤ 2 * (g : ℤ) →
   169	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (N - D')) 1))
   170	    (hNdeg : 2 * (g : ℤ) ≤ CurveDivisor.deg K N)
   171	    (D D' : Y.CurveDivisor)
   172	    (hD0 : 0 ≤ D) (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K D = (g : ℤ))
   173	    (hD'0 : 0 ≤ D') (hdeg' : CurveDivisor.deg K D' = (g : ℤ))
   174	    (h : divisorSections K (N - D) ⊤ = divisorSections K (N - D') ⊤) :
   175	    D = D' := by
   176	  refine CurveDivisor.ext_coeffAt (fun x hx => ?_)
   177	  rw [← baseDivisorAt_window_normalization g hO hχ N hNnorm hNdeg D hD0 hdeg hx,
   178	    ← baseDivisorAt_window_normalization g hO hχ N hNnorm hNdeg D' hD'0 hdeg' hx, h]
   179	
   180	end WindowRecovery

    11	
    12	The `hreg` discharge for `LocalEquations.pullback` along the relative-curve comparison
    13	`relCurveMap C R R'` (`informal/spec-dd-1.md` §3 stage (c), the DD-1a row): for a
    14	certified divisor adaptation, the pulled equations have nonzerodivisor germs at every
    15	point, so the pulled system `d' = d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')` exists — with **no

    52	/-- A ring isomorphism carries nonzerodivisors to nonzerodivisors. -/

    54	    (e : A ≃+* B) {a : A} (ha : a ∈ nonZeroDivisors A) : e a ∈ nonZeroDivisors B := by

    56	  obtain ⟨hl, hr⟩ := ha
    57	  constructor
    58	  · intro b hb

    60	    rw [map_mul, map_zero, e.symm_apply_apply] at h
    61	    have hb0 : e.symm b = 0 := hl _ h
    62	    calc b = e (e.symm b) := (e.apply_symm_apply b).symm
    63	      _ = 0 := by rw [hb0, map_zero]

   146	sheaf inject into the product of their germs. -/
   147	theorem eqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors (j : A.index) :
   148	    A.eqn j ∈ nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C R, A.pieces j) := by
   149	  rw [mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_right]
   150	  intro t ht
   151	  apply TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext (relCurve C R).sheaf (A.pieces j) t 0
   152	  intro z hz
   153	  rw [map_zero]
   154	  have key : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j) z hz).hom t
   155	      * ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j) z hz).hom (A.eqn j) = 0 := by
   156	    rw [← map_mul, ht, map_zero]
   157	  exact (mul_left_mem_nonZeroDivisors_eq_zero_iff (A.eqn_regular j z hz)).mp
   158	    (by rw [mul_comm] at key; exact key)
   159	
   160	/-- **The pulled equations are section-level regular** (Kleiman `lm:ctn` (i)⟹(iii) made
   161	cheap; no hypothesis on `R'`): the colength `Γ(D(h_j))⧸(f_j)` is projective hence flat
   162	over `R`, so `f_j` stays regular in `R' ⊗[R] Γ(D(h_j)) ≅ Γ(D(h'_j))`
   163	(`includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_flat_coker` through the piece-level term
   164	identification). -/
   165	theorem pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
   166	    (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) (j : A.index) :
   167	    A.pulledEqn R' j ∈
   168	      nonZeroDivisors Γ(relCurve C R', (A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j) := by
   169	  haveI := hproj j
   170	  have hreg := Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_mem_nonZeroDivisors_of_flat_coker
   171	    (R := R) R' (A.eqn j) (A.eqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors j)
   172	  have h2 := map_mem_nonZeroDivisors
   173	    (A.toFinCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange R' j).toRingEquiv hreg
   174	  have h1 : (A.toFinCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange R' j).toRingEquiv
   175	      (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (A.eqn j)) = A.pulledEqn R' j := by
   176	    rw [Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight_apply]
   177	    exact A.toFinCoverData.pieceTermBaseChange_one_tmul R' j (A.eqn j)
   178	  rwa [h1] at h2
   179	
   180	/-- **The `hreg` discharge** (DD-1a): germs of the pulled equations of `d` are
   181	nonzerodivisors at every point of the pulled cover members. Each point lies in a piece;
   182	there the pulled equation differs from the pulled piece equation — regular by
   183	`pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors` + the affine germ seam — by a stalk unit assembled from
   184	the adaptation unit and the transition unit of `d`. -/
   185	theorem germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors
   186	    (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j))
   187	    (y z : relCurve C R')
   188	    (hz : z ∈ (d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) :
   189	    ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
   190	        ((d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R')).opens y) z hz).hom
   191	        (Scheme.LocalEquations.pullbackEqn (relCurveMap C R R') d y)
   192	      ∈ nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) := by
   193	  obtain ⟨j, hzj⟩ := (A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').exists_mem_pieces z
   194	  -- the point below `z` and its memberships
   195	  have hzj' : z ∈ relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ A.pieces j := by
   196	    rw [← A.toFinCoverData.pieces_baseChange R' j]
   197	    exact hzj
   198	  have hfzj : (relCurveMap C R R').base z ∈ A.pieces j := hzj'
   199	  have hfzy : (relCurveMap C R R').base z ∈ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y) :=
   200	    hz
   201	  have hfzW : (relCurveMap C R R').base z ∈
   202	      A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y) :=
   203	    ⟨hfzj, hfzy⟩
   204	  -- the regular germ of the pulled piece equation
   205	  have hF : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
   206	      ((A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom (A.pulledEqn R' j) ∈
   207	      nonZeroDivisors ((relCurve C R').presheaf.stalk z) :=
   208	    IsAffineOpen.germ_mem_nonZeroDivisors
   209	      ((A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').isAffineOpen_pieces j)
   210	      (A.pulledEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' hproj j) z hzj
   211	  -- germ of the pulled piece equation = stalk image of the germ of the piece equation
   212	  have hgermF : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
   213	      ((A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom (A.pulledEqn R' j) =
   214	      ((relCurveMap C R R').stalkMap z).hom
   215	        (((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j)
   216	          ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzj).hom (A.eqn j)) := by
   217	    have happ := (relCurveMap C R R').germ_stalkMap_apply (A.pieces j) z hfzj (A.eqn j)
   218	    -- `pulledEqn = res (app (eqn))`, so its germ over the piece is the germ of
   219	    -- `app (eqn)` over the preimage
   220	    have hres : ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
   221	        ((A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom (A.pulledEqn R' j) =
   222	        ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
   223	          (relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ A.pieces j) z hzj').hom
   224	          (((relCurveMap C R R').app (A.pieces j)).hom (A.eqn j)) := by
   225	      have hle : (A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j ≤
   226	          relCurveMap C R R' ⁻¹ᵁ A.pieces j :=
   227	        A.toFinCoverData.baseChange_pieces_le_preimage R' j
   228	      have := TopCat.Presheaf.germ_res_apply (relCurve C R').presheaf
   229	        (homOfLE hle) z hzj (((relCurveMap C R R').app (A.pieces j)).hom (A.eqn j))
   230	      rw [← this]
   231	      rfl
   232	    rw [hres, happ]
   233	  -- decompose the germ of the piece equation through the pointwise unit clause of the
   234	  -- adaptation at the base point of `y`
   235	  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := A.eqn_rel j ((relCurveMap C R R').base y)
   236	  have hdecomp : ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ (A.pieces j)
   237	      ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzj).hom (A.eqn j) =
   238	      ((relCurve C R).presheaf.germ
   239	          (A.pieces j ⊓ d.cover.opens ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))
   240	          ((relCurveMap C R R').base z) hfzW).hom

300	        (d.eqn ((relCurveMap C R R').base y))) =
   301	      ↑hunit.unit⁻¹ *
   302	        ((relCurve C R').presheaf.germ
   303	          ((A.toFinCoverData.baseChange R').pieces j) z hzj).hom (A.pulledEqn R' j) := by
   304	    rw [hkey, ← mul_assoc, Units.inv_mul, one_mul]
   305	  rw [hSM]
   306	  exact mul_mem hunit.unit⁻¹.isUnit.mem_nonZeroDivisors hF
   307	
   308	/-- **The pulled local-equation system** on the relative curve over `R'`: `d` pulls back
   309	along the relative-curve comparison, with regularity discharged by the certificate's
   310	colength projectivity. -/
   311	noncomputable def pulledEquations (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
   312	    (relCurve C R').LocalEquations :=
   313	  d.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') (A.germ_pullbackEqn_mem_nonZeroDivisors R' hproj)
   314	
   315	@[simp]
   316	lemma pulledEquations_cover (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
   317	    (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).cover = d.cover.pullback (relCurveMap C R R') :=
   318	  rfl

   321	lemma picClass_pulledEquations (hproj : ∀ j, Module.Projective R (A.colength j)) :
   322	    (A.pulledEquations R' hproj).picClass =
   323	      Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C R R') d.picClass :=
   324	  Scheme.LocalEquations.picClass_pullback (relCurveMap C R R') d _

    13	
    14	The substrate of the field window→functionField dictionary `Φ`
    15	(`informal/spec-w4-gates.md` §G-3; the keystones `divFamPhi`/`divFamPhi_injective`/
    16	`map_divFamPhi_eps_fst` live in `AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorFamilyFieldDictionary`):
    17	over a field extension `K/k`, the relative theta twist `𝒪(Θᵃ)` on the fibre curve `C_K`
    18	is trivialized meromorphically, and its global sections are read into `K(C_K)` with
    19	image exactly the section space of the presentation divisor.

    21	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.dvd_iff_ord_le` /
    22	  `Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_mem_stalkIdeal_iff_ord_le` — **the stalk-ideal ↔ order
    23	  dictionary**: membership in the stalk ideal of a divisor family at a closed point is
    24	  the order bound against the family's local equation (DVR divisibility is valuation
    25	  comparison).
    26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.thetaFieldChartIndex` / `thetaFieldPointedCover` — a
    27	  **deterministic** chart selector (`inl` on `V₀ᴷ`, `inr` off it) and the pointed cover
    28	  by whole pinned charts it indexes.
    29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.thetaFieldPresentation` / `thetaFieldDivisor` — the meromorphic
    30	  presentation of the `K`-level whole-chart theta datum on that cover

    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.picClass_thetaFieldDivisor` /
    33	  `picClass_windowTransportDivisor_eq_thetaFieldDivisor` — the class laws: `N₀(a)` lies
    34	  in the `K`-level theta class, which is also the class of the **transported** window
    35	  divisor `windowTransportDivisor C K π a` (the abstract `N` of the DDR-2 `N`-pack) —
    36	  `cechPicClass_baseChange_thetaChartDatum` closes the base-change seam; the **shift
    37	  unit** `thetaFieldShiftUnit` realizes the difference as a principal divisor.

    39	  are glued sections on the pointed cover (`gluedTwistEquiv`, then `gluedSubordEquiv`),

    41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.thetaFieldRead` — **the reading** `H⁰(𝒪(Θᵃ)) →ₗ[K] K(C_K)`: the

    59	/-! ## The stalk-ideal ↔ order dictionary at a closed point -/
    60	
    61	section StalkOrder
    62	
    63	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] {X : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    64	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] [IsIntegral X]
    65	
    66	/-- **Divisibility in a DVR stalk is valuation comparison** (the engine of the
    67	stalk-ideal ↔ order dictionary): for elements `y, e` of the stalk at a closed point with
    68	`e ≠ 0`, `e ∣ y` exactly when the order of `y` in the function field is at most that of
    69	`e`.  Total divisibility of the valuation ring, with the unit case read off
    70	`valuation_eq_one_iff_notMem`. -/
    71	theorem Scheme.dvd_iff_ord_le {z : X} (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X)
    72	    {y e : X.presheaf.stalk z} :
    73	    e ∣ y ↔
    74	      Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
    75	          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField y)
    76	        ≤ Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
    77	            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField e) := by
    78	  letI := isDiscreteValuationRing_stalk (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
    79	  letI := isDedekindDomain_stalk (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
    80	  have hord : Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
    81	      = (stalkHeightOne X z).valuation X.functionField := rfl
    82	  rw [hord]
    83	  constructor
    84	  · rintro ⟨c, rfl⟩
    85	    rw [map_mul, Valuation.map_mul]
    86	    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right' ((stalkHeightOne X z).valuation_le_one c)
    87	  · intro hle
    88	    rcases eq_or_ne y 0 with rfl | hy
    89	    · exact dvd_zero e
    90	    rcases ValuationRing.dvd_total e y with hdvd | hdvd
    91	    · exact hdvd
    92	    · -- `y ∣ e`: the cofactor has valuation `1`, hence is a unit
    93	      obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hdvd
    94	      have hyne : (stalkHeightOne X z).valuation X.functionField
    95	          (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField y) ≠ 0 := by
    96	        simp only [ne_eq, Valuation.zero_iff]
    97	        exact fun h0 =>
    98	          hy ((map_eq_zero_iff _
    99	            (IsFractionRing.injective (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField)).mp h0)
   100	      have hcge : (1 : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ))
   101	          ≤ (stalkHeightOne X z).valuation X.functionField
   102	              (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField c) := by
   103	        have he' : (stalkHeightOne X z).valuation X.functionField
   104	            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField e)
   105	            = (stalkHeightOne X z).valuation X.functionField
   106	                (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField y)
   107	              * (stalkHeightOne X z).valuation X.functionField
   108	                (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField c) := by
   109	          rw [← Valuation.map_mul, ← map_mul, ← hc]
   110	        rw [he'] at hle
   111	        exact (mul_le_mul_iff_right₀ (zero_lt_iff.mpr hyne)).mp (by rwa [mul_one])
   112	      have hcunit : IsUnit c := by
   113	        have h1 : (stalkHeightOne X z).valuation X.functionField
   114	            (algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField c) = 1 :=
   115	          le_antisymm ((stalkHeightOne X z).valuation_le_one c) hcge
   116	        rw [IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation_eq_one_iff_notMem] at h1
   117	        exact IsLocalRing.notMem_maximalIdeal.mp h1
   118	      obtain ⟨u, rfl⟩ := hcunit
   119	      exact ⟨(u⁻¹ : (X.presheaf.stalk z)ˣ), by
   120	        rw [hc, mul_assoc, Units.mul_inv_eq_one.mpr rfl, mul_one]⟩
   121	
   122	/-- **The stalk-ideal ↔ order dictionary** (the pole-bound bridge of the DD-4 field
   123	dictionary): the germ at a closed point `z` of a section `β` lies in the stalk ideal of
   124	the divisor family `d` exactly when the order at `z` of its rational-function reading
   125	`germ_η β` is bounded by the order of `d`'s local equation — i.e. of the trivializing
   126	element `d.presentation.elem z`. -/
   127	theorem Scheme.LocalEquations.germ_mem_stalkIdeal_iff_ord_le (d : X.LocalEquations)
   128	    {U : X.Opens} (hηU : genericPoint X ∈ U) {z : X} (hzU : z ∈ U)
   129	    (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X) (β : Γ(X, U)) :
   130	    (X.presheaf.germ U z hzU).hom β ∈ d.stalkIdeal z ↔
   131	      Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
   132	          ((X.presheaf.germ U (genericPoint X) hηU).hom β)
   133	        ≤ Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz
   134	            ((d.presentation.elem z : X.functionField)) := by
   135	  have hβ := Scheme.germ_generic_eq_algebraMap_germ hηU hzU β
   136	  have helem : (d.presentation.elem z : X.functionField)
   137	      = algebraMap (X.presheaf.stalk z) X.functionField
   138	          ((X.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens z) z (d.cover.mem_opens z)).hom (d.eqn z)) := by
   139	    rw [Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_elem_val]
   140	    exact Scheme.germ_generic_eq_algebraMap_germ (d.cover.genericPoint_mem_opens z)
   141	      (d.cover.mem_opens z) (d.eqn z)
   142	  rw [Scheme.LocalEquations.stalkIdeal, Ideal.mem_span_singleton, hβ, helem]
   143	  exact Scheme.dvd_iff_ord_le K hz
   144	
   145	/-- **The stalk ideal at the generic point is everything**: the local equation is
   146	regular, so its germ at `η` is a nonzero element of the function *field* — the
   147	generic-point clauses of the vanishing submodule are vacuous. -/
   148	theorem Scheme.LocalEquations.stalkIdeal_genericPoint (d : X.LocalEquations) :
   149	    d.stalkIdeal (genericPoint X) = ⊤ := by
   150	  rw [Scheme.LocalEquations.stalkIdeal, Ideal.span_singleton_eq_top]
   151	  have hne : (X.presheaf.germ (d.cover.opens (genericPoint X)) (genericPoint X)
   152	      (d.cover.mem_opens (genericPoint X))).hom (d.eqn (genericPoint X)) ≠ 0 :=
   153	    mem_nonZeroDivisors_iff_ne_zero.mp
   154	      (d.regular (genericPoint X) (genericPoint X)
   155	        (d.cover.mem_opens (genericPoint X)))
   156	  exact isUnit_iff_ne_zero.mpr hne
   157	
   158	/-- The order of the trivializing element of the presentation of a divisor family is
   159	the divisor bound of the **negated** presentation divisor: `ord_z (elem z)` prescribes
   160	exactly the zero the divisor demands. -/
   161	theorem Scheme.LocalEquations.ord_presentation_elem
   162	    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))] (d : X.LocalEquations) {z : X}
   163	    (hz : z ≠ genericPoint X) :
   164	    Scheme.ord (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz ((d.presentation.elem z : X.functionField))
   165	      = Scheme.divisorBound (-Scheme.presentationDivisor K d.presentation) hz := by
   166	  rw [← Scheme.coe_inv_ordZ K (d.presentation.elem z) hz]
   167	  have hbound : Scheme.divisorBound (-Scheme.presentationDivisor K d.presentation) hz
   168	      = ((Multiplicative.ofAdd
   169	            (coeffAt hz (-Scheme.presentationDivisor K d.presentation)) :
   170	          Multiplicative ℤ) : WithZero (Multiplicative ℤ)) :=
   171	    rfl
   172	  have hcoeff : coeffAt hz (-Scheme.presentationDivisor K d.presentation)
   173	      = Multiplicative.toAdd
   174	          ((Scheme.ordZ (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) hz (d.presentation.elem z))⁻¹) := by
   175	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.coeffAt_neg hz,
   176	      Scheme.coeffAt_presentationDivisor K d.presentation hz, toAdd_inv]
   177	  rw [hbound, hcoeff, ofAdd_toAdd]
   178	
   179	end StalkOrder

   181	/-! ## The deterministic pointed cover by the pinned charts -/
   182	
   183	section Cover
   184	
   185	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   186	variable (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   187	variable (π : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite π]
   188	
   189	open Classical in
   190	/-- **The deterministic chart selector**: `inl` on the first pinned chart `V₀ᴷ`, `inr`
   191	off it.  Unlike the datum's `pieceIndex` (a `Classical.choose`), the branch is
   192	*provable*: `x ∈ V₀ → thetaFieldChartIndex x = inl`. -/
   193	noncomputable def thetaFieldChartIndex (x : relCurve C K) : (thetaChartCover C K π).index :=
   194	  if x ∈ (relCover C K (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀ then Sum.inl PUnit.unit
   195	  else Sum.inr PUnit.unit
   196	
   197	lemma thetaFieldChartIndex_of_mem {x : relCurve C K}
   198	    (hx : x ∈ (relCover C K (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) :
   199	    thetaFieldChartIndex C K π x = Sum.inl PUnit.unit :=
   200	  if_pos hx
   201	
   202	lemma thetaFieldChartIndex_of_notMem {x : relCurve C K}
   203	    (hx : x ∉ (relCover C K (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) :
   204	    thetaFieldChartIndex C K π x = Sum.inr PUnit.unit :=
   205	  if_neg hx
   206	
   207	/-- A point off the first pinned chart lies in the second: the pinned charts cover. -/
   208	lemma mem_V₁_of_notMem_V₀ {x : relCurve C K}
   209	    (hx : x ∉ (relCover C K (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀) :
   210	    x ∈ (relCover C K (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by
   211	  have hx' : x ∈ (relCover C K (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   212	      ⊔ (relCover C K (fiberTwoCover π)).V₁ := by rw [relCover_sup]; trivial
   213	  rcases (TopologicalSpace.Opens.mem_sup).mp hx' with h0 | h1
   214	  exacts [absurd h0 hx, h1]
   215	
   216	/-- Every point lies in the whole-chart piece its selector picks. -/
   217	lemma mem_pieces_thetaFieldChartIndex (x : relCurve C K) :
   218	    x ∈ (thetaChartCover C K π).pieces (thetaFieldChartIndex C K π x) := by
   219	  by_cases hx : x ∈ (relCover C K (fiberTwoCover π)).V₀
   220	  · rw [thetaFieldChartIndex_of_mem C K π hx, thetaChartCover_pieces_inl]
   221	    exact hx
   222	  · rw [thetaFieldChartIndex_of_notMem C K π hx, thetaChartCover_pieces_inr]
   223	    exact mem_V₁_of_notMem_V₀ C K π hx
   224	
   225	/-- **The deterministic pointed cover by the pinned charts**: the member through `x` is
   226	the whole chart selected by `thetaFieldChartIndex`. -/
   227	noncomputable def thetaFieldPointedCover : (relCurve C K).PointedCover where
   228	  opens x := (thetaChartCover C K π).pieces (thetaFieldChartIndex C K π x)
   229	  mem_opens x := mem_pieces_thetaFieldChartIndex C K π x
   230	
   231	@[simp]
   232	lemma thetaFieldPointedCover_opens (x : relCurve C K) :

    12	Upgrades the germ **divisibility** bridge `germ_relThetaResSide_dvd_iff_ord_le`
    13	(`DivSchemeUnivFibreHdiv.lean`, `15d9eb465`) to a `K`-**linear submodule** identification,

events.text: A concrete reusable brick is now clear: after normalizing any nonzero subspace `T ≤ H⁰(O(A))` by its base divisor, the residual base multiplicity is zero. This is exactly the missing abstract statement needed by the pointwise `A = N − d_p` lane, and it can be proved from the already-landed achiever/lower-bound lemmas without new geometry. I’m checking `BaseDivisor.lean` through LSP before adding it.

The generic residual-base theorem now has zero LSP diagnostics. It states that `T` becomes basepoint-free relative to `A − bd(T)` and closes by applying the existing exact achiever plus the universal lower bound. Next I’m specializing it to the universal seed fibre, where `bd(H⁰(N−d_p), N) = d_p`.
